name: Ashley Carreras
evidenceNote: ORCID record (linked from his Alfaisal profile): Ph.D. Social Sciences, University of Leicester, completed 2000-07; employment De Montfort University 1989-09 to 1996-08, Kingston University (Kingston Business School) 1996-09 to 2001-12, De Montfort University 2002-01 to 2017-08, Loughborough University 2017-09 to 2020-01, Alfaisal from 2020-01. The Kingston post began well before the degree and continued, so the first new post-PhD job is De Montfort University from January 2002; ORCID gives no role titles.
reason: Under the overlap rule, a job held through the degree is not the first post-PhD job; the ORCID chronology dates the next new job (De Montfort University, January 2002), but not its rank. The Alfaisal bio names his roles there (Head of Undergraduate and Postgraduate Studies) without dates.
